title: Sprint the Floor, No Ball
description: Players sprint full-court lanes with no ball at all, purely building the conditioning and lane discipline that transition offense depends on.

content.objective: Build the conditioning and lane discipline for transition without the ball to worry about yet.
content.setup: Three players line up across the baseline in the left, middle and right lanes.
instructions: Sprint the full length of the floor staying in the assigned lane.
Touch the far baseline, then jog back staying wide, not cutting through the middle.
Repeat for a set number of full-court sprints.
Rotate lanes each trip so every player runs each one.
coachingPoints: Stay in your lane the whole way — don't drift toward the ball handler's lane out of habit.
Sprint at genuine game speed, not a jog disguised as a sprint.
Recover with a real jog, not a walk, to keep the conditioning value.
commonMistakes: Drifting out of the assigned lane partway down the floor.
Walking back instead of jogging, losing the conditioning benefit.
Bunching into the same lane instead of spreading the floor.
content.safety: Make sure all three lanes are clear of equipment and other groups.
